messages:
anya: Customer reported CI eval failures after yesterday's model variant rollout. Failing test: evals/golden/price_lookup_toolcall.json — 8/10 runs flagged as schema mismatch.
kevin: Looking at nightly logs. I see intermittent responses where tool_call.arguments is a JSON-encoded string rather than an object.
kevin: Example response snippet:
```
"tool_call": {
  "name": "price_lookup",
  "arguments": "{\"sku\":\"ABC123\",\"country\":\"US\"}"
}
```
samir: That pattern often means the serializer double-serialized the arguments in the streaming path. Repro locally against model v2-quant with the golden prompt — I can reproduce ~30% of runs.
maria: CI job ci-eval-3421 shows the failures. I marked the job flaky to avoid blocking other merges. Created a Jira: RED-8342.
ci-bot: Created Jira RED-8342: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-8342 — autom. ticket for toolcall args stringified.
anya: Customer is seeing their smoke tests fail in their pipeline; they've escalated. They want a workaround ASAP. :grimacing: 
kevin: Short-term mitigation: update the eval harness to attempt JSON.parse on tool_call.arguments when it's a string. That'll stop false positives in CI.
samir: Long-term: patch the runtime to emit a proper JSON object in the streaming/model adapter. I'll open a PR to coerce/normalize the toolcall shape at the serializer boundary and add unit tests.
maria: I'll unflake the CI, apply harness change, and re-run the nightly after kevin's small patch. ETA: harness patch in ~1 hour, runtime hotfix in next 6-12 hours.
kevin: Also adding a regression test: golden prompt + model variants + a specific check that arguments is an object. Add metric to alert when fraction of stringified-args > 0.5% over 1h.
anya: Repro steps for support to share with customer:
```
# curl example
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat.completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"v2-quant","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"lookup price for sku ABC123 country US"}],"stream":false}'

# inspect tool_call
# failing output includes: "arguments": "{\"sku\":\"ABC123\",...}"
```
anya: Next actions: samir to open runtime PR, kevin to patch harness + add regression cases, maria to update CI job and re-run, anya to keep customer updated and attach RED-8342. Marking this P2 for infra but P1 for customer-facing support.
kevin: I'll post PR links when ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
